values.zh-CN: **柯里化。** 性质中的 h 已取值于 C(X,Y)，因而每个切片连续，反柯里化 F(z,x)=h(z)(x) 是良类型的。若 F 连续，对 F({z}×K)⊆U，逐点取乘积开邻域，再用 K 的有限子覆盖，得到 z 的开邻域 W 使 F(W×K)⊆U。因此 h⁻¹([K,U]) 开；此方向不使用局部紧性。反向由 F=ev∘(h×id) 及联合求值连续得到。对原始 F:Z×X→Y，只在各切片连续后，才将已有 Type.Curry(F) 看作取值于 C(X,Y) 的映射。这里不宣称两层函数空间之间的同胚。
values.en: For currying, h already takes values in C(X,Y), so all slices are continuous. If its uncurrying F is continuous, a finite product-neighborhood cover of {z} times K supplies a neighborhood W of z with F(W times K) contained in U. Thus h is continuous without local compactness. Conversely use joint evaluation and h times the identity. A raw F can only be regarded as a C(X,Y)-valued curry after its slices are known continuous; no mapping-space homeomorphism is asserted.
